title: avena strigosa proles brevis
intro: Avena strigosa proles brevis, commonly known as oat grass or oat straw, is a type of grass belonging to the Avena genus. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, as well as its therapeutic actions, which may include sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Avena strigosa proles brevis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, oat grass is a rich source of beta-glucans, which have been shown to stimulate the immune system and have prebiotic properties.
